tasks.title: Six provider-content quick fixes
tasks.objective: Replace the truncated-base64 binary fallback with typed guidance (audio/video/archive/iWork/unknown), read .eml as text, implement Slack snippet delivery (UTF-8 size chooses snippet vs .txt before upload; any provider failure falls back to the split text path so delivery is never lost), classify Discord voice notes as audio, keep Telegram location/venue/contact data (incl. venue address), and fold all human-readable Discord embed text under per-embed caps plus the router aggregate budget.
acceptance_criteria: no code path emits base64 for unrecognized binaries; guidance is typed per family and unit-tested per family
.eml reads as raw text; .msg takes the guidance path

snippet vehicle chosen by UTF-8 bytes BEFORE upload (<=1MB snippet_type text, >1MB plain .txt); provider failure of the upload path falls back to existing split/truncate delivery — replay and failure paths tested
Discord audio/* attachments classify as audio; Telegram venue fixture asserts title+address+lat+lon; contact fixture asserts name+phone

embed folding covers title/description/url/fields/author.name/footer.text/media descriptions, bounded per-embed in UTF-8 bytes, and the combined body passes the router aggregate budget (max-body + multibyte fixture)

required_tests.id: provider attachment materialization reads > describes binary attachments with typed guidance instead of base64
required_tests.command: VITEST_JUNIT=1 FORGE_TEST_ID={id} npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts {path} --outputFile {report}

tasks.title: Slack canvas read/create/update behind host-issued handles
tasks.objective: Implement the slack canvas module, IPC handlers, and three runner MCP tools with split READ/WRITE capability sets and strict IPC bounds per the plan; channel_id-bound creation with files.info permalink and free-team handling; honest last-write-wins with host-side serialization; canvas+file scopes in the canonical install surfaces + doctor. READ ships behind runtime scope/error gates; the live export spike is deferred by recorded decision (see acceptance criterion 1).
acceptance_criteria: DEVIATION RECORDED (Ravi 2026-08-04): the live export spike is deferred — the bot token lacks files:read (host-side spike hit missing_scope; workspace reinstall is a pending human action). READ SHIPS implemented against the documented canvas-as-file export (url_private bearer fetch, body as bounded text), gated at runtime: missing_scope or export failure returns an honest error naming the required scopes and the reinstall; fake-HTTP tests are the proof. No live-spike evidence is required to close this task.
runner never supplies raw canvas ids; update handles mint exclusively from the WRITE set; a shared-in canvas gets a READ handle only — pinned by test
creation passes the host-derived channel_id; free_team_canvas_tab_already_exists returns the existing bound canvas; permalink via files.info with tested non-fatal failure
IPC bounds enforced host-side before provider calls (oversize markdown/title, multi-op, unknown fields all rejected loudly, boundary-tested)
section targeting fails explicitly on zero/multiple matches; stale handles rejected; lock/conflict provider errors surface as retryable messages; host serializes its own edits per canvas
canvases:read + canvases:write in the canonical install scope list, setup flow, and doctor with re-auth guidance; fresh-install and upgraded-install scope tests
Harness paths (factory/, constitution vendor stamps) are in scope solely for the review-driven companion-gate fix re-vendored from symphony-forge @ f9de7109. Fixed upstream first, then re-vendored.
